newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taipei gives away free condoms for safe Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Taipei gives away free condoms for safe Christmas.

text.p: The Taipei city government on Tuesday gave away 30,000 free condoms to ensure that Christmas will be "merry and safe" for residents of Taiwan's capital.
The government had planned to hand out only 10,000 condoms, but tripled the supply after passersby emptied the giveaway stand in just one hour, a government spokeswoman said.
"It looks like people are really concerned about both safety and fun," she said by telephone.
